To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the oxygen diffusive shunt is a mechanism that allows for a more uniform distribution of oxygen tension in tissue and that this shunt is particularly important under conditions of heterogeneous blood flow.
oxygen diffusive shunts exist in tissues with heterogeneous capillary perfusion.
the presence of heterogeneous flow in capillaries leads to a significant increase of oxygen tension in the region of the tissue poorly supplied by the nearest capillaries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of capillary-tissue interactions under conditions of heterogeneous blood flow.
the development of a mathematical model of the oxygen transport in tissue and its use in the analysis of various physiological and pathological processes.
the analysis of oxygen transport from a heterogeneous vascular system to tissue.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the oxygen diffusive shunt is a significant mechanism for oxygen transfer under conditions of heterogeneous blood flow.
oxygen transport from capillaries to tissue depends on the geometry of the tissue and on the geometry of blood vessels in the tissue.

under the conditions of heterogeneously distributed flow, diffusion can significantly contribute to the oxygenation of the poorly oxygenated tissue regions, and the contribution of diffusion is more significant the more distant the capillaries are.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the oxygen tension at a given site of the tissue depends on the oxygen delivery rate to this site, the oxygen consumption rate in the region of interest, and the geometry of the capillaries and the tissue.
the oxygen tension is not a good indicator of the oxygen tension.
the oxygen diffusion shunting is significant in tissues supplied by capillaries with heterogeneous flow.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, under conditions of heterogeneous blood flow and oxygen transport, oxygen diffusion from more remote capillaries can play a significant role in the overall oxygenation of the tissue.
the presence of oxygen diffusion shunts can be important for tissue oxygenation in cases of heterogeneous oxygen delivery.

the presence of a heterogeneous oxygen delivery system can significantly increase the amount of oxygen available for consumption at any given site of tissue, thus increasing the overall oxygen consumption of the tissue.
